compression_timing_note: block sensitivity (Gram) + lambda selection on 32 dev seqs (5 allocate/prune/dev-PPL passes) + final pruning; outlier-proxy record excluded

hellaswag.task_version: Rowan/hellaswag@218ec52e09a7e7462a5400043bb9a69a41d06b76 split=validation, 2000 locked IDs (hellaswag_val_locked.jsonl.gz, seed 6304), zero-shot, lm-evaluation-harness acc_norm convention (loglik / len(ending) in characters)

format.context: activity_label + ': ' + ctx  (fallback ctx_a + ' ' + ctx_b if ctx is empty)
format.tokenization: tok(context) + tok(' ' + ending), add_special_tokens=False, tokenized separately and concatenated; every continuation token scored once
format.metrics: raw_acc = argmax sum loglik; acc_norm = argmax loglik / len(ending in characters)

latency.label: dense FP16 execution (no sparse or low-bit kernels; zeros and dequantized weights are stored and multiplied densely)

decode_64_after_prefill_512.definition: 64 greedy decode forward passes (1 token each, KV cache) after an untimed-in-this-number 512-token cached prefill; timed separately

sparsity.definition: fraction of eligible weights that are exactly zero after compression

dense_fp16_bytes.label: dense
dense_fp16_bytes.definition: 2 bytes x every unique parameter (tied counted once)

theoretical_sparse_fp16_bytes.label: theoretical
theoretical_sparse_fp16_bytes.definition: 1 mask bit per eligible weight (byte-aligned) + 16 bits per nonzero eligible weight + FP16 uncompressed params; a representation estimate, not allocated GPU memory

calibration_output_error.definition: D = W_compressed - W_fp16; output_err = tr(D G D^T)/n_tokens; rel_output_err = tr(D G D^T)/tr(W G W^T); G = sum_t x_t x_t^T over the 128 calibration sequences, with inputs x_t taken from the UNMODIFIED FP16 model (not the compressed model's own inputs).

p3.unit: Transformer block (all 7 eligible projections share s_l)
p3.sensitivity_definition: sum_p tr(D_p G_p D_p^T) / sum_p tr(W_p G_p W_p^T), D_p = W_p*mask_p - W_p, mask_p = P2 Wanda mask at s_probe, G_p from the unmodified FP16 model
p3.rule: s_l = clip(S + lam*(1 - 2 r_l) + c, 0.10, 0.85); c by bisection; largest-remainder integerisation per projection, per-row counts differ by <= 1

rejected_outlier_proxy.definition: OWL-style weight-only: mean over the block's projections of max|W|/mean|W|
rejected_outlier_proxy.why_rejected: ignores activations and the mask actually applied; does not measure the output error pruning causes
